changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricRuleParameter_MetricRule') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[RuleParameter] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricRuleParameter_MetricRule] END
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'RuleParameter') BEGIN DROP TABLE [metrics].[RuleParameter] END
changeSet.rollback:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'RuleParameter') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[RuleParameter]( [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](50) NOT NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](4000) NULL, [LookupClass] [int] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_MetricRuleParameter] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [Uid] ASC, [Name] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricRuleParameter_MetricRule') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[RuleParameter] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricRuleParameter_MetricRule] FOREIGN KEY([Uid]) REFERENCES [metrics].[Rule] ([Uid]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [metrics].[RuleParameter] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricRuleParameter_MetricRule] END
